purpose: Politely combine a visit with another purpose.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Action noun + かたがた + movement verb
I will visit to greet you and express my thanks.
I visited the laboratory and took the opportunity to report back.
I visited to wish her well and share my news.
formation: Action noun + かたがた + movement verb
restrictions: Common with お礼, ご挨拶, お見舞い, and ご報告.
mistake: Typically accompanies a visit, not two unrelated abstract actions.
